finalOutput:
I have created the complete Snake game in a single self-contained file named **`snake_openrouter-google-gemini-3.8-flash_01.html`**.

### Features Included:
- **Grid & Movement**: Classic 30x30 grid rendered cleanly on an HTML5 `<canvas>`, with continuous 4-directional movement, body segment interpolation, and growth upon consuming food.
- **Collisions & Game Over**: Full collision detection for outer wall boundaries, self-collisions, and mutual body collisions between snakes.
- **Three Game Modes**:
  - **Human vs Human (PvP)**: Player 1 uses Arrow Keys (Green), Player 2 uses WASD keys (Blue).
  - **CPU vs Human (PvE)**: Player 1 controls with Arrow Keys or WASD; CPU navigates using BFS pathfinding.
  - **CPU vs CPU (Spectate / Bot Battle)**: Both snakes autonomously seek food and avoid obstacles.
- **AI Pathfinding (CPU)**: Breadth-First Search (BFS) routing towards food with fallback survival/open-space heuristics to prevent self-trapping.
- **UI & Menus**:
  - Interactive Start Menu with mode selection and speed settings.
  - Live in-game HUD displaying scores for both players and high scores.
  - Game Over screen detailing the match winner or cause of death.
- **Keyboard Restart**: Press <kbd>Space</kbd> or <kbd>Enter</kbd> anytime during the Game Over screen (or click the restart button) to quickly play again.
